create_ModelSection_config: create a ModelSection dataclass to configure model name, path, family, arch, dtype, and compile options
create_TrainerSection_config: create a TrainerSection dataclass to configure FSDP, mixed precision, gradient accumulation, and activation checkpointing
create_OptimizerSection_config: create an OptimizerSection with AdamWConfig to set learning rate, betas, weight decay, and parameter groups
create_LRSchedulerSection_config: create an LRSchedulerSection with CosineAnnealingLRConfig to set warmup steps, cycle length, and final learning rate
create_RegimeSection_config: create a RegimeSection dataclass to configure training steps, validation intervals, checkpointing, and metric publishing
